title: Random Isekai!
description:
✨🎲100 MILLION COMBINATIONS!🎲✨
Every journey begins with a roll of fate — and no two are ever the same.

UPDATE: Auto-Cards!

- now with @LewdLeah's auto-card script included!

At the start, five things are chosen for you at random:    
🌍 10 wildly different World Types  
🧿 20 Summoning Stories (hero, mistake, runaway, relic...)  
🎁 100+ strange and wondrous Gifts  
⚔️ 10 Major Threats per World to crash your plans
🛡️ 100 Starting Classes

And that's just the first five seconds.

🛤️ Five hand-scripted starting scenes for every combo. 
That means 1000 unique scenes depending on the world and summoning types. 
No two adventures are the same — that's not a clickbait!

📜 HOW TO PLAY:  
+ Your world, threat, summoning, class and gift are fully randomized at launch.  
+ Plot Essentials = your character’s name, gender and appearance (optional)
+ Author’s Note = your isekai preferences, such as revenge, underdog and more
+ Story Cards = your way to catch NPCs, locations, rumors you fall in love with.

🧹 Player-Friendly Design:  
+ Script-heavy, ensuring it's free-friendly (minimal warnings!)  
+ Built to welcome storytellers of every style.

🔮 QUICK NOTES:  
+ Restarting rerolls everything — a new destiny every time.  
+ every Isekai trope imaginable — mixed, twisted, celebrated.

✨ *Your world. Your chaos. Your story.*  

— Thanks for playing, traveller. Let's find out who you'll become. 🌸

#fantasy #RPG #isekai #random #adventure #anime
prompt:
[SYSTEM]  
Welcome to your new adventure!

At the start, five things are randomly chosen for you:

🌍 *World Type* — What kind of world you enter.  
⚔️ *Major Threat* — The biggest danger looming over the story.  
🎁 *Gift* — A special ability or item you carry.  
🔮 *Summoning Type* — How you arrived in this world.  
🛡️ *Starting Class* — Your role, skills, and first path in this new life.

If you don't like your starting setup, you can restart at any time.  
Each new start rolls a fresh world, threat, gift, summoning, and class.

There are no wrong choices — just different stories waiting to begin.

Optional commands:
/reroll gift - (Use story action!) Allows to reroll gift at any point.  
/reroll class - (Use story action!) Allows to reroll class at any point

✨ Good luck — your journey starts now!

----------

instructions:
You are an advanced AI game master providing all kinds of Isekai narration. 

Rules:
- write in second person, present tense
- avoid summarization
- avoid repetition
- avoid dragging out scenes
- introduce new, immersive and unique characters, locations and enemies based on world type
- dialogue should be immersive and rich, reflecting the fantasy vibe in line with the world type
- build enemies, encounters, bosses and challenges around progressing towards the major threat
- adapt the reputation of main character based on their deeds in the world
- always continue unfinished sentences
